title: AC1024 associative value-dependency physical span profile

scope.purpose: Decode and bound the source-backed body, string, and handle suffix spans for the three audited local witnesses; do not qualify recursive graph output or other producer/version profiles.

independentDecode.source: Candidate raw bit-span decoder cross-checked against LibreDWG 0.14 peer JSON and graph joins recorded in p4-ac1024-value-dependency-handle-code-profile-2026-10-30.json and p4-ac1024-assoc-value-dependency-closure-2026-10-30.json.
independentDecode.result: All decoded value kinds and values match the peer target-variable projection; the remaining body and string tails are bounded and the handle stream ends in byte-alignment padding.

wireProfile.body: BS class version 0, TV value name, BS value discriminator 40 or 90, then BD real or BL signed 32-bit integer.
wireProfile.string: The value name is encoded as TV; these witnesses use the empty name and the bounded string stream is consumed exactly.
wireProfile.handles: The four common references use the witnessed 4/4/4/3 tuple. The residual handle bits are exactly the count needed to reach the next byte boundary; their values are not required to be zero.
wireProfile.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, sections 2.2–2.4 for bit-code framing and 20.1 for common nonentity-object framing and B* handle-stream byte alignment.

implementationTrace.method: Temporary debug trace of the production dwg2dxf AC1024 parser, removed after evidence collection.
implementationTrace.wireComplete: 77/77 records report class version 0, a supported 40/90 value code, parsed typed fields, and complete bounded body/text/handle spans.
implementationTrace.readFailures: All three imports report entityParseFailures=0 and objectParseFailures=0.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 value-dependency typed suffix parser retains class version, value name, and either a finite real or signed 32-bit cached value. It accepts only exact byte-alignment padding in the handle stream, checks the observed handle-code tuple, and keeps unknown or malformed suffixes wire-incomplete. The DXF writer emits the typed subclass and refuses incomplete or invalid typed state.
implementation.failureBehavior: Generated vectors reject mismatched handle codes. The writer's value-dependency late-EED failure rolls back bytes and source identity, and the corrected same-object retry succeeds.

physicalImports.result: All three sources have zero entity/object parser failures and each of their 77 total value-dependency records is wire-complete. Strict complete conversion still exits 1 and creates no output because the whole read disposition remains incomplete; the separate ACDBASSOCVARIABLE suffix is a known unresolved P4 blocker.
